India's Industrial Output Grows 5.1% in May Driven by Key Sectors

India's industrial production saw a significant increase of 5.1% year-on-year in May, reaching a five-month high. This growth was primarily propelled by strong performance in the manufacturing and electricity sectors, with capital goods also showing a notable expansion. The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation released the data, also noting methodological adjustments to the Index of Industrial Production series.
